to be a blanket /(.*) -> /index.html, so a request for a missing build asset
such as /admin-layout-572YJ7EE.js was answered with index.html and HTTP 200.
The browser then tried to evaluate HTML as an ES module and reported 'Failed
to fetch dynamically imported module', which gives no hint that the real
problem is a chunk name from an older build. Excluding extensions lets a
missing asset return an honest 404, while SPA routes such as
The headers stop the browser caching index.html. That file names every
hashed chunk, so a cached copy is precisely what leaves a client asking for
chunks a newer deployment no longer has. The hashed assets stay immutable,
since their filename changes whenever their contents do.
